exposure: elective, nonmedically indicated deliveries at 37 or more weeks of gestation and before 39 weeks of gestation
cesarean delivery performed in low-risk mothers
cohort: All delivery hospitalizations in New York City in 2010
finding: The maternal quality indicators elective delivery before 39 weeks of gestation and cesarean delivery performed in low-risk mothers were not associated with severe maternal complications or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery performed in low-risk mothers was not associated with severe maternal complications or neonatal morbidity.
